narrative:
Union County has 49,505 registered voters, with 17.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 33.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.1%, a clear Democratic lean of 10.2 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 28.3% of registrants.
